changes: Initialize persisted left/right dock intent from the selected appearance's desktop layout even when the viewport is mobile; mobile startup still presents the safe canvas-first view.

Applying a preset while mobile updates in-memory desktop intent without persisting responsive drawer visibility. An explicit mobile drawer selection persists exactly the selected side and clears the other saved side.
The asynchronous mobile More-actions details toggle now closes visible drawers with save:false so an event queued before a preset choice cannot overwrite the newly selected desktop layout.

Added a real Chromium regression that selects the balanced preset on a 390px mobile viewport, verifies both docks remain closed on mobile, returns to desktop and verifies both docks plus a 400px minimum canvas, then explicitly chooses the left mobile drawer and verifies that this choice becomes the desktop layout. No Page Model, Save or Publish request is issued.
